name: HUAWEI WATCH 6
summary: Huawei's 2026 flagship smartwatch in 42 mm and 46 mm, with eSIM calls, sapphire glass and up to 11 days of battery (46 mm). Malaysian pre-orders until 2 November 2026; on sale and priced from 3 November.

display.note: 46 mm; the 42 mm model has a 1.38-inch screen (338 PPI)

battery.claim: 46 mm: up to 4.5 days typical (3 days always-on); battery saver up to 11 days light, 7 days typical. 42 mm: 3 days typical, up to 7 days in battery saver

build.note: 42 mm: aluminium case; spherical sapphire glass

default.note: From SoyaCincau's report of Huawei Malaysia's pre-order (27 October 2026).

MY.note: Pre-orders open; Huawei Malaysia announces the price at the 3 November 2026 launch.
